fields.name: interfaces
fields.schema_type: array[$ref InterfaceRef {device: string (required), interface: string (required), membership: anyOf[string, null] default null}]

client_only_validation: at least one row with both device and interface ('Add at least one device/interface row')
half-filled row: device without interface -> 'Interface name is required'; interface without device -> 'Device name is required'

membership required on every complete row ('Select a membership type'); server treats null/blank InterfaceRef.membership as the workflow default (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/activities/ib_pkey/normalization.py:38-46)
fields.submit_transform: sent only when input_mode == 'interfaces'; rows filtered to non-empty (trimmed) device AND interface and mapped to {device, interface, membership}; key omitted in GUID mode (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:282-293)

each GUID matches ^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{16}$ ('Invalid GUID. Expected 0x + 16 hex digits.'); no schema pattern and no model validator
fields.submit_transform: sent only when input_mode == 'guids'; non-empty trimmed guid strings from the rows (row objects flattened to string[]); key omitted in interfaces mode (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:294-296)

fields.label: Membership for GUID row N (aria-label only; placeholder 'Membership Type')
fields.schema_description: Per-GUID membership types corresponding to the supplied GUIDs.
fields.ui_default: "" per GUID row (stored on the guids row objects)
fields.widget_today: select per GUID row (part of the guids row editor)

options.notes: MEMBERSHIP_OPTIONS (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:57-60); schema items are plain string

client_only_validation: membership required on every non-empty GUID row ('Select a membership type'); server accepts [] (falls back to membership_type) and only requires len(guid_memberships) == len(guids) when non-empty (_ib_pkey_helpers.py:86-93)
values limited to full|limited client-side; server normalizes case-insensitively and rejects others (normalization.py:21-35)
fields.submit_transform: sent only when input_mode == 'guids'; built from the same filtered rows as guids so it is index-aligned (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:295-299)

payload_transform: body = {host, pkey} (zod-trimmed). input_mode == 'interfaces' -> body.interfaces = rows with non-empty device and interface mapped to {device, interface, membership}; input_mode == 'guids' -> body.guids = non-empty guid strings and body.guid_memberships = the same rows' membership values. The inactive branch key is omitted; input_mode, membership_type and ip_over_ib are never sent (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:275-300). startWorkflow POSTs to /v1/workflow/ngc/ib_pkey_member_update; 2xx redirects to /workflows/{id}; on error a destructive 'Workflow Failed' toast is shown and the submit button re-enabled (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:302-309, ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184).
discrepancies: Schema fields not rendered or submitted: membership_type (string, default 'full') and ip_over_ib (boolean, default true) (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/ib_pkey_member_update.py:154-160). The UI exposes per-row membership instead of the workflow-level default.

Membership is required per row in the UI (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:121-127,146-152) but optional server-side: null/blank InterfaceRef.membership falls back to the workflow default and guid_memberships [] falls back to membership_type.

Membership enum full|limited exists only in the UI; schema types are plain string (membership_type, guid_memberships items, InterfaceRef.membership anyOf[string, null]) and allowed values are enforced only by validators (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/activities/ib_pkey/normalization.py:17-46).

pkey: UI regex and the server field_validator agree on ^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}$ (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/_ib_pkey_helpers.py:60-68) but JSON Schema has no pattern; the server canonicalizes to 0x%04x while the UI submits the trimmed raw value.
GUID format ^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{16}$ is client-only (ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:55,138-145); no schema pattern or model validator.

interfaces XOR guids and guid_memberships length alignment are enforced by the model_validator (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/_ib_pkey_helpers.py:71-93), not by JSON Schema (both default []); the UI guarantees it via the mode switch and by omitting the inactive branch.
Fully empty rows are silently dropped before POST; half-filled interface rows block submit client-side.
The MSW mock rejects malformed GUIDs and pkeys at POST (ui/src/mocks/handlers/ibPkeyMemberHandlers.ts:35-36,60-63,84-86); the real model validates pkey format but has no GUID format check.
Labels differ from schema titles ('UFM Host'/'Host', 'PKey'/'Pkey', 'GUIDs'/'Guids'); schema descriptions are not displayed.

Static destructive warning ('This reconciles PKey membership to the list below. Any current members not present here will be removed. Removals require approval before they execute.') is UI copy passed as a page prop (ui/src/app/workflows/ibpkeymemberupdateworkflow/form/page.tsx:28, rendered at ui/src/components/forms/workflow/ib-pkey-membership-form.tsx:542-549); no schema counterpart.
ip_over_ib schema description ('IP over InfiniBand setting used when the partition does not already exist.') implies a create-on-update path that the UI cannot configure.
e2e coverage (ui/tests/e2e/ibPkeyMemberUpdateForm.spec.ts) does not exercise URL prefill or client-side pkey/GUID validation for this slug.
contract_gaps: interfaces is an array of $ref objects (list[InterfaceRef]); the generic renderer has no row/array-of-object editor and rejects nested editable arrays.
input_mode is a UI-only discriminator, not a model field; visible_if.field must reference a sibling model field, so the interfaces/GUIDs switch cannot be expressed. Only op 'equals' would be needed.
The legacy form omits the inactive branch. Sending the default [] still passes the server XOR but breaks byte-identical parity; sending stale rows from the other mode fails the XOR.
No radio widget in the v1 vocabulary (select is the nearest).

One shared component serves add/update/delete with per-workflow props (title, submitLabel, includeMembershipType, destructiveWarning); ui_component is a bare string, so either three registry keys or an adapter keyed on the workflow name is needed.
guids and guid_memberships are edited as one row list and zipped into two index-aligned arrays; v1 has no parallel-array transform.
Static options (membership full|limited) have no v1 source: OptionSource requires an endpoint, and adding a schema enum would change the input schema (out of scope for 505).
membership_type and ip_over_ib cannot be hidden (no hidden key); inference would render them and initial_values would add them to the payload.
Static destructive-warning alert copy has no v1 key.
